name: Anantha Filament Works Ltd
what_it_makes: Specialty polyester filament yarn: spun on its own extrusion lines, then textured and twisted in-house for some orders.
ownership: BSE-listed. Promoter family holds the board; the MD is a professional, not family.

fy26.revenue_note: Audited revenue includes Rs 8.4 Cr of other operating revenue (waste yarn and export incentives), which is not in the account ledger.
fy26.commercial_team: 9: one Commercial GM, four regional managers, four inside sales

contribution_caveat: The ERP holds no manufacturing cost per kg for any product. The three contribution rates above are Finance's annual estimate per segment. Any contribution figure for an order or an account is therefore an estimate, and should be shown as one.

changeover.filament_or_denier_change: 12 hours line-down, about 900 kg of output foregone, about Rs 47,000 of contribution
changeover.colour_family_change: 380 kg written off as cleaning and loss quantity, about Rs 1.58 lakh
changeover.trial_lot_note: A 500 kg trial lot earns about Rs 26,000 of contribution and costs at least Rs 47,000 to set up.
changeover.campaign_rule: A special polymer (cationic, FR, recycled) is run only when at least 4 t of orders for it are booked. Below that, orders wait.

competitors.name: Vasanta Technical Yarns
competitors.note: Same machines, 18.5% operating margin, 11 application engineers, 40% specialty volume.

mandate.statement: EBITDA from Rs 13.4 Cr to Rs 24 Cr by the end of FY28, on roughly the same tonnage.
mandate.confidence_bands: low < directional < strong. A direction is later reconciled as validated, contradicted or insufficient (too early or too thin to tell).

bridge.lever: Shift 8 points of volume from commodity to specialty
bridge.why_this_confidence: No named buyer yet holds more than 40 t a year of specialty demand.

bridge.lever: Close 2 points of the price gap on the five largest traders
bridge.why_this_confidence: Peer-price comparison covers 75-88% of their kilos.

bridge.lever: Halve colour-family changeover losses by sequencing
bridge.why_this_confidence: Changeover count is logged; loss per change is an engineering estimate.

bridge.lever: New accounts that buy on specification, not price
bridge.why_this_confidence: Two pursuits past sampling in 12 months.
